title: アエロ・ダイブ：最果ての蒼い境界線
author: 天野 ソラ

en.title: Aero Dive: The Azure Boundary at the World's End
en.premise: Kyle, a genius mechanic, believes in the legend of a 'true land' hidden beneath the vast sea of clouds. To find it, he constructs the Zephyros, a small airship powered by a forbidden, ultra-high-speed engine. Alongside an unlucky former military pilot and a navigator with no memory, Kyle dives into the abyss of the clouds, fleeing the pursuit of the Imperial Army in a desperate race toward the world's end. Cutting through the wind and piercing the heavens, the boys' journey for freedom and kinship begins.

zh.title: Aero Dive：世界尽头的苍蓝境界线
zh.premise: 天才整备师凯尔深信云海之下存在着“真正的陆地”。为了揭开这个传说，他打造了一艘搭载禁忌超高速引擎的小型飞空艇——“西风号”。在一名运气不佳的前军人飞行员与一名失忆航海士的陪伴下，他们一边甩掉帝国军的追击，一边向着世界的尽头，潜入云海的深渊。劈风斩云，追求自由与羁绊的少年们的疾走之旅，就此开启。

prediction_results.question: ゼフィロス号は次に何をする？
